svg.text: 1. `try_emplace`: Attempts to insert a key-value pair if key does not exist
2. `insert`: Inserts a key-value pair into the map
3. `erase`: Removes an element with the specified key
4. `find`: Searches for an element with the specified key
5. `count`: Returns the number of elements with the specified key
6. `size`: Returns the number of elements in the map
7. `clear`: Removes all elements from the map
